entries.en: How's your day goin'? Win anything?
entries.ro: Cum o duci? Ai câștigat ceva?

entries.en: Hold up. It's pay to get inside.
I've got some easy corpo prey for you.
entries.ro: Am pentru tine niște corpoi ușor de jupuit.

entries.en: To get into a card joint? Weird.
entries.ro: Ca să intri într-un cazino de cărți? Ciudat.

entries.en: You got it all wrong, big guy. See, friend of mine's fixin' to bring in some easy corpo prey, hot with loose wallets. Wanna ask your boss how much we can get per head fleeced.
entries.en_m: You got it all wrong, big guy. Ya see, friend of mine's fixin' to bring in some easy corpo prey, hot with loose wallets. I wanna ask your boss how much we can get per head fleeced.
entries.ro: Te-ai înșelat, băiatule. Uite, un prieten de-al meu tocmai aduce niște corpoi ușor de jupuit, cu portofelele bine umflate. Vreau să-l întreb pe șeful tău cât putem scoate de pe fiecare cap.

entries.en: First time I hear a casino havin' entrance fees.
entries.ro: Prima oară aud de un cazinou care cere taxă de intrare.

entries.en: Don't agree with it, then fuck off. No one's forcing ya.
entries.ro: Dacă nu ești de acord, atunci cară-te dracu'. Nu te forțează nimeni.

entries.en: OK, go on in. But I don't wanna see any funny biz, all right?
entries.ro: Bine, intră. Dar să nu-mi văd chestii dubioase, da?

entries.en: If I didn't spend 'em all second I got 'em – yeah.
entries.ro: Dacă nu le-am cheltuit pe toate imediat ce le-am primit – da.
